## Migrator.reset() method

Roll back every batch.

**Signature:**

```typescript
reset(): Promise<string[]>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;string\[\]&gt;

Names of the migrations reversed.

## Remarks

Runs each migration's `down`<!-- -->, so it depends on those being correct. When they are not, [Migrator.fresh()](./database.migrator.fresh.md) is the blunter alternative.
